# thoth_tool_classification (Resource)

Declare reviewed tool effects. Requires tenant admin authentication, or an approver when no admin exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "thoth_tool_classification" "read_orders" {
  tool_name = "orders.list"
  classes   = ["read"]
}

resource "thoth_tool_classification" "delete_order" {
  tool_name = "orders.delete"
  classes   = ["delete"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `classes` (Set of String) Reviewed effects: read, write, delete, execute, export, external_call, bulk_operation, credential_access, sensitive_data_access.
- `tool_name` (String) Exact tool name; wildcards are refused.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
